query:
INSERT INTO chat_mcp_servers (chat_id, mcp_server_id)
           SELECT $1, s.id
           FROM mcp_servers s
           WHERE s.id IN (SELECT unhex(value, '-') FROM json_each($3))
             AND (s.user_id = $2
                  OR s.id IN (SELECT mcp_server_id FROM mcp_server_users WHERE user_id = $2))
